description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the percentage of matched and not matched responses across six categories: No Hallucination, Oriented, Active, Self-aware, Rigorous, and Correct. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, in the order presented, with no apparent sorting. The horizontal axis represents percentage values, labeled from 0% to 100% with tick marks at 20% intervals, and represents the scale for the bar lengths. Each category has two bars representing “Matched” and “Not Matched”, colored blue and gray respectively. For “No Hallucination”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 98.33% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 1.67%. The “Correct” category has a “Matched” bar extending to 99.00% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to 1.00%. The “Self-aware” category has a “Matched” bar extending to 94.00% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to 6.00%. The “Rigorous” category has a “Matched” bar extending to 95.33% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to 4.67%. The “Oriented” category has a “Matched” bar extending to 97.33% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to 2.67%. The “Active” category has a “Matched” bar extending to 97.00% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to 3.00%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
